ev.q: The efficacy for prevention of HPV 6, 11, 16, or 18-related genital warts among males who received at least 1 vaccine dose
Population included all males who received at least 1 vaccine dose, regardless of baseline DNA or serology, with case counting beginning after day 1.
This report presents the ACIP policy statement and summarizes background data.
Issues reviewed by ACIP included efficacy, immunogenicity, and safety of the HPV4 vaccine in males
